changed_behaviour: Enums: Permission redefined one bit per ability (View=1 Edit=2 Create=4 Delete=8 Share=16 Comment=32 Download=64 Move=128 Copy=256 Trash=512 Restore=1024 Manage=2048, all()=4095); Ability::bits() returns its own bit (@closed, values unchanged); GrantLevel deleted; Effect only for PermissionDriver::override; new InheritanceRestriction {empty, copy_current}.
Roles: Vaulter\Access\Roles\Role{key, version, abilities} and RoleRegistry v1 previewer/reader/commenter/writer/organizer/owner; UnknownRoleException (unknown_role, 422).

Resolver: effective abilities = union of roles of direct grants + subtree grants of ancestors up to and including the first inherit_grants=false node + PermissionDriver decisions; override Deny blocks, Allow is super; no deny, no max(rank). Decision{Role role}; GrantSet{allowedBits, superAllow, superDeny}; AclMask/AclFolder simplified to union.
Explain: AccessExplanation{allowed, ability, reason, sources: list<AccessSource>, restrictions, boundaryNodeId}; AccessSource{grantId, subject, role, roleVersion, originNodeId, inherited, expiresAt}.
API: GrantInput{subject, role, scope, expiresAt}; access()->restrictInheritance(node, InheritanceRestriction)/restoreInheritance(node) (Manage); grants unique (node, subject_type, subject_id, scope).

Guard: copy = view+download+copy on every copied node (copyableSubtree) + create on destination; move = move + destination create; restore = restore + destination create when not the original parent; purge = delete.
Drivers: gate/spatie/azgard map role keys (previewer added: vaulter.preview); resolve returns Decision{Role}; NullPermissionDriver on roles; AccessScope.nodeOwner and Gate context node_owner removed.
